report:
# events-fall — dated events Sep 28 – Dec 31, 2026

**Totals:** 97 events and 30 series records. All pages were read on 2026-09-27 (Sunday).

**By kind:** market 24, holiday 15, festival 13, family 11, food-drink 9, cultural 7, parade 7, exhibition 4, concert 3, fair 2, film 1, fireworks 1.
**By region (sheet):** tampa 28, clearwater 24, stpete 20, around 9, daytrips 8, beaches 8.
**By start month:** 2026-09 1, 2026-10 49, 2026-11 28, 2026-12 14, started before Sep 28 5.

## What is covered
Festivals (Clearwater Jazz Holiday, Tampa Pig Jig, John's Pass Seafood Festival, Tarpon Springs Seafood Festival, Tampa Greek Festival, Oktoberfest Tampa, Piertoberfest, SHINE, SAVOR St. Pete, Sanding Ovations, Dunedin Wines the Blues, Dunedin Celtic Festival, Plant City Pig Jam, BayFest, Largo Vibe Fest, St. Pete Fall Festival, Armature Works Fall Fest, Florida Fin Fest, St. Pete Country Fest, Haunted Fest), theme-park seasons (Busch Gardens Howl-O-Scream and Christmas Town, LEGOLAND Brick or Treat and Christmas Bricktacular, Florida Aquarium Guppyween), Halloween (Halloween on Central, Riverwalk Trick-or-Treat, History Center Night at the Museum, Fall-O-Ween, Dunedin golf-cart parade and trick-or-treating, Safety Harbor Fright Nights, Water Street Whispers After Dark, pet and dog parades, pumpkin patches and farm festivals), holiday lights and tree lightings (Holiday Lights in the Gardens, Largo Central Park lights, Shimmering Lights, Santa Fest, Water Street Season Spectacular, Clearwater, Safety Harbor and Snow Place Like Tarpon Springs), boat parades (Tampa Riverwalk, Alafia, Clearwater), New Year's Eve (Clearwater Sunset to Sparkle), market series (Ybor, St. Pete Saturday Morning, Corey Ave, Hyde Park Fresh Market, Safety Harbor, Dunedin, Gulfport Tuesday and Night markets, Madeira Beach Wednesday, Water Street and Seminole Heights Sunday markets) as date + end_date + time_text (and occurrences for monthly ones), art and craft shows and holiday markets, community and cultural events (Tampa Theatre's 100th birthday on Oct 15 and the Plant Museum's Cigar City Cinema centennial exhibit, Fiesta SOMOS St. Pete, Hispanic Heritage Month at the Dalí, Navratri and India Festival at the fairgrounds, Plant City Pioneer Day, Veterans Day ceremonies in Largo and Safety Harbor), two Dalí exhibitions, the Hillsborough County Fair, and day-trip events (Sarasota Medieval Fair, Siesta Key Crystal Classic, St. Armands and Sarasota fall art festivals, Hunsader Farms Pumpkin Festival).

Series: 30 records for the recurring signature events; 20 reuse the ids the events-spring slice already wrote for the annual calendar (howl-o-scream, christmas-town-busch-gardens, clearwater-jazz-holiday, santa-fest-tampa, winter-village-tampa, …) so the merge unites them. Series without a 2026 date on the organizer's page are recorded as series only, with the last published date in when_text: winter-village-tampa, florida-aquarium-yuletides, tarpon-springs-christmas-parade, tarpon-springs-illuminated-boat-parade.

## How candidates were found
WebSearch was unavailable to this agent (the session's search budget was already used) and Bing, DuckDuckGo, Qwant and Brave returned bot pages, so discovery used lists read directly:
- Visit Tampa Bay: its sitemap.xml lists 388 /tampa-events/details/ pages; the festival, holiday, market and community listings that looked visitor-scale were read (concerts, games, classes, walks and bar crawls were left to other slices or skipped). The /tampa-events/september/ round-up was read; October to December round-ups do not exist yet (404).
- Visit St. Pete-Clearwater: /events, /events-festivals, /fall, /winter pages and event listings (Saturday Morning Market, Corey Ave Sunday Market, Holiday Lights in the Gardens, Clearwater Jazz Holiday).
- The Events Calendar REST feeds (wp-json/tribe/events/v1) of the St. Pete Pier, I Love the Burg (329 St. Pete-area events), Hyde Park Village, Tampa Bay History Center, the Dalí, Tampa Museum of Art, Sunken Gardens, the St. Pete Arts Alliance, the Florida State Fairgrounds, the Anna Maria Island Chamber, Bok Tower Gardens, Carrollwood Cultural Center, MFA St. Pete and Pinellas County.
- City calendars: City of Tampa featured events and Santa Fest; Safety Harbor (special-events list, December month view and each event page); Tarpon Springs (Nov and Dec month views); Clearwater (Coachman Park and Clearwater Beach event pages); Dunedin (event directory URLs from its sitemap); Largo Recreation special events; Madeira Beach events; St. Pete Beach and Treasure Island calendars (nothing relevant posted).
- Organizer schedules: SIK Promotions (fall craft shows, Tarpon seafood festival, Early Elf, Gulfport night market), Paragon Festivals, Tampa Bay Markets, Tampa Riverwalk events, Water Street Tampa, Armature Works, LEGOLAND seasonal events, Busch Gardens, Florida Aquarium, Clearwater Yacht Club.
- Wikipedia's List of festivals in Florida (food festivals by month) and the events-spring slice's series list were used only as candidate lists; each record's facts come from its own source page.

## Deliberately left out, and why
- TIGLFF 2026 ran Sept 10-13 (St. Pete) and Sept 18-20 (Tampa): outside the window (tiglff.com).
- Guavaween: guavaween.com is a parked domain and the Ybor City Chamber calendar (Sep 28 - Dec 31) lists no Guavaween or Ybor Halloween parade. No record.
- St. Pete First Night: firstnightstpete.com is a parked lander page. No record.
- ZooTampa seasonal events: zootampa.org is behind a SiteGround captcha for both curl and WebFetch, and web.archive.org is blocked here. Nothing read, no record (a gap to fill).
